Who shows up

You deal with the owner — every time.

I'm Dmitrii. I run Justinas Outdoor Services myself — named after my daughter, Justina. I give you the quote, I show up on the day, and I do the work. No call center, no rotating crews, no subcontractors. You'll know exactly who's at your house.

I run commercial-grade 4,200 PSI equipment and match the method to the surface — gentle on siding, strong on concrete.
